title: Project Context
subtitle: Markdown documents from this repository's default branch. Attach them to an agent or a skill so reviews are grounded in your specs. Read-only — change a document in git, then Rescan.

empty.title: No documents found
empty.body: To add one: commit a .md file under specs/, docs/ or insights/, push it to the default branch, then click Rescan.

notCloned.title: Repository not cloned yet
notCloned.body: Project context is read from the local clone of this repository. Once the repository has been cloned, its documents appear here.

row.usedBy: {count, plural, one {Used by # agent} other {Used by # agents}}

unattachableHint.too_large: Agents and skills can attach documents up to {limit} KB. You can still preview it; split it into smaller documents to attach it.
unattachableHint.not_utf8: Only UTF-8 text documents can be attached or previewed.

preview.title: Document preview
preview.injectionBody: This document contains text that looks like instructions to an AI model. If attached, it could try to override an agent’s instructions.
preview.select: Select a document’s Preview to read it here.
preview.tooLargeBody: This document is {size} KB, over the {limit} KB limit for agents and skills. You can read it here, but it can’t be attached. Split it into smaller documents to attach it.
preview.tooLargeToPreview: This document is {size} KB, too large to preview here (limit {limit} KB). Open it in your editor or on the code host.
preview.notUtf8: This document isn’t UTF-8 text, so it can’t be previewed.

warning.fetch_failed: Couldn’t update the repository from the remote. Showing the documents in the local clone as they are on disk.
warning.timeout: Updating the repository took too long. Showing the documents in the local clone as they are on disk.

attach.overBudget: Over the {budget}-token project context budget. A run would skip: {paths}

noRepo.title: No repository selected
noRepo.body: Pick a repository in the sidebar to attach its documents.
